Concrete species reference D.elderae, not old D.altus label or African Dysalotosaurus.","scientific_limits":{"en":"Original living reconstruction, not scan. Carnegie CM3392 mount includes substantial casts and sculpted restoration;2007 account reports only35% original bones and about25% newly sculpted. Head is checked against NPS adult skull cast; soft tissue, posture and missing parts remain inferred. Three metres is an approximate museum-mount display scale, not complete fossil measurement.","zh":"完整活体美术复原，非扫描。Carnegie CM3392装架含大量翻模与雕塑补配，2007馆方说明原骨约35%、约25%新塑。头部另核NPS成年头骨翻模；软组织、姿态及缺失部分属推断。3米为约定展件尺度，非完整化石实测。"},"inventory_ordinal":368,"name":{"en":"Dryosaurus","zh":"橡树龙"},"taxon":"Dryosaurus elderae","classification":"Dinosauria, Ornithischia, Ornithopoda, Dryosauridae","scale":{"total_length_m":3.0,"basis":"Carnegie2007 describes roughly10-foot mount; current NPS gives broad8-14foot estimates and2.4m smaller adult example. Three metres is approximate within that range."},"diagnostic_targets":["Slender extended neck joins small tapered beaked head to a moderately deep torso.","Long lightly built hindlimbs and narrow distal legs, distinct from stocky adult sauropodomorphs.","Short five-fingered forelimbs held free, no Iguanodon thumb spike.","Long tapering tail balances bipedal body; no horns, large predator teeth or armour.","Retain genuine neck/leg proportions versus compact short-necked Hypsilophodon, not size-only distinction."],"specimen_basis":"Actual Carnegie mounted skeleton side photograph and official frontal photo inspected; NPS adult skull cast image with inch scale inspected. Current NPS species name D.elderae used, original genus scope preserved."}
